data.name: LeviBio
data.value: Possesses near-superhuman reflexes due to awakened Ackerman bloodlines. Lethal with vertical maneuvering equipment.

data.name: MikasaBio
data.value: Equal to a hundred ordinary soldiers in combat. Driven by an absolute, singular drive to protect Eren Yeager at all costs.

data.name: StoryPageSub
data.value: A comprehensive archive of the military campaigns, political coups, and catastrophic events that shaped the world.

data.name: Arc1Desc
data.value: The century of fragile peace is shattered when the Colossal and Armored Titans breach Wall Maria. Humanity is forced to retreat behind Wall Rose, losing one-third of its territory and countless lives, including Eren's mother, sparking his vow to eradicate all Titans.

data.name: Arc2Desc
data.value: Five years after the fall of Wall Maria, Eren, Mikasa, and Armin enlist in the military. Alongside a diverse group of cadets, they undergo brutal training to master the Omni-Directional Mobility gear and prepare for the frontlines.

data.name: Arc3Desc
data.value: The Colossal Titan strikes again, breaching Trost District. During the desperate defense, Eren is swallowed by a Titan, only to awaken his own Titan power. Using this newfound form, he seals the breach, marking humanity's first victory against the Titans.

data.name: Arc4Desc
data.value: Eren is placed under Levi's custody in the Special Operations Squad. During the 57th Expedition, a highly intelligent Female Titan attacks, slaughtering the squad. After a fierce battle in Stohess District, she is unmasked as fellow cadet Annie Leonhart, who crystallizes herself to avoid interrogation.

data.name: Arc5Desc
data.value: Titans mysteriously appear within Wall Rose. In the chaos at Utgard Castle, Ymir reveals her Titan form. Shortly after, Reiner and Bertholdt reveal themselves as the Armored and Colossal Titans, kidnapping Eren and triggering a rescue mission where Eren first unleashes the Coordinate power.

data.name: Arc6Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps faces persecution from the corrupt Royal Government. Led by Erwin and Levi, they orchestrate a coup d'état to overthrow the puppet king and place Historia Reiss on the throne, uncovering the dark secrets of the Reiss family and the Titan inheritance.

data.name: Arc7Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps launches a high-stakes campaign to reclaim Wall Maria. They defeat the Beast, Armored, and Colossal Titans at a devastating cost, losing Commander Erwin. Armin inherits the Colossal Titan, and Eren finally reaches his basement to discover the truth of the outside world.

data.name: Arc8Desc
data.value: The perspective shifts to the nation of Marley. Following Eren's infiltration, he launches a devastating surprise attack on Liberio during Willy Tybur's declaration of war. Eren consumes the War Hammer Titan, cementing Marley and Paradis in a state of absolute, total war.

data.name: Arc9Desc
data.value: Factions splinter on Paradis as the Yeagerists seize control. Marley launches a sudden aerial counter-invasion. Eren and Zeke make contact to enter the Paths, where Eren rejects Zeke's euthanasia plan and instead convinces Ymir Fritz to grant him the full power of the Founding Titan.

data.name: Arc10Desc
data.value: The Rumbling is unleashed, marching millions of Wall Titans to flatten the world. An alliance of surviving Marleyan Warriors and Paradis soldiers pursue Eren. In a final battle atop the Founder, Mikasa kills Eren, ending the Titan curse and leaving the remaining population to build a fragile future.

data.name: Time1Desc
data.value: The Colossal and Armored Titans breached Wall Maria, ending a century of fragile human peace.

data.name: Time2Desc
data.value: Eren Yeager launched a surprise raid on Liberio, shifting the global war into its endgame.

data.name: Time3Desc
data.value: Titans breached the southern gate of Wall Rose. Eren Yeager's Titan power awakened for the first time, sealing the breach and saving humanity from the brink of collapse.

data.name: Time4Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps ventured beyond the Walls in their largest operation. A Female Titan hunted Eren relentlessly, and was ultimately unmasked as Annie Leonhart.

data.name: Time5Desc
data.value: Wall Rose was apparently breached. In a shocking betrayal, Reiner Braun and Bertholdt Hoover revealed themselves as the Armored and Colossal Titans.

data.name: Time6Desc
data.value: Eren Yeager activated the Power of the Founding Titan, unleashing millions of Wall Titans in a cataclysmic march to annihilate all life beyond Paradis.

data.name: Time7Desc
data.value: The Alliance of Paradis and Marley made their final stand at Fort Hakuai. Eren was slain by Mikasa, ending the Rumbling and the cycle of hatred at the cost of the world they knew.

data.name: T1Desc
data.value: The nexus of all titans. Wields the ultimate 'Coordinate' ability to alter memories and command millions of Wall Titans to initiate the Cataclysmic 'Rumbling'.

data.name: T2Desc
data.value: Possessed by Annie Leonhart. Exhibits high all-around agility, specialized localized crystalline hardening defenses, and a vocal call that summons pure titans.

data.name: T3Desc
data.value: Held by Zeke Yeager. Resembles an ape-like beast capable of devastating long-range bombardment. Due to royal blood, his spinal fluid instantly transforms targets.

data.name: T4Desc
data.value: Held by Bertholdt, then Armin. Possesses a mountainous structure. Transformation triggers a pseudo-nuclear thermal blast, alongside a tactical high-pressure burning steam defensive barrier.

data.name: T5Desc
data.value: Held by Reiner Braun. Encased in a heavy hardened skeletal armor plating that provides fortress-grade defensive metrics. Functions as an organic battering ram against fortified structures.

data.name: T6Desc
data.value: Held by Ymir, Falco, and others. The smallest form but unmatched in top-tier agility. Features powerful claws and jaws that can crush even the densest crystalline hardening.

data.name: T7Desc
data.value: Held by Pieck Finger. Utilizes a quadrupedal stance with unparalleled physiological endurance, allowing months of sustained transformation. Can be equipped with customized heavy military artillery.

data.name: T8Desc
data.value: Originally held by the Tybur family. Features absolute weapon materialization via dense structural hardening. The host can safely remain underground while managing the titan puppet remotely via a cable connection.

data.name: T9Desc
data.value: The core combat avatar managed by Eren Yeager. Features balanced combat stats, flawless tactical grit, and the unique cross-temporal memory foresight capability.

data.name: C1Bio
data.value: Possesses near-superhuman reflexes due to awakened Ackerman bloodlines. Unmatched with vertical maneuvering equipment, universally hailed as Humanity's Strongest.

data.name: C2Bio
data.value: Equal to a hundred ordinary soldiers in combat. Graduated from the 104th Training Corps alongside Eren, driven by an absolute, singular drive to protect him at all costs.

data.name: C3Bio
data.value: Eren and Mikasa's childhood friend. Possesses an extraordinary tactical mind, devising brilliant counter-strategies in dire situations. Inherited the Colossal Titan.

data.name: C4Bio
data.value: Led the Scout Corps' scientific research and weapon development, notably creating the Thunder Spears. Succeeded Erwin as the 14th Commander with high integrity.

data.name: C5Bio
data.value: A legendary leader with frozen resolve and hypnotic charisma. Developed the Long-Distance Scouting Formation. Sacrificed himself to historical truth.

data.name: C6Bio
data.value: A grounded realist who understands weakness, enabling him to assess battlefields accurately from a soldier's view. Became a highly trusted field commander.

data.name: PollInstruction
data.value: Where does your loyalty lie in the final conflict?

data.name: G1Desc
data.value: A revolutionary invention enabling humanity to fight titans. Utilizes high-pressure gas cylinders and steel wire anchors to allow high-speed 3D mobility through trees and urban structures.

data.name: G2Desc
data.value: Standard-issue melee cutlery forged from industrial black-bamboo alloy. Engineered for high flexibility and razor sharpness to slice titan flesh. Features an instant segment-reload design.

data.name: G3Desc
data.value: A specialized heavy anti-titan armor-piercing rocket weapon developed by Hange. Anchors directly into target frameworks and detonates via a tethered cord, strong enough to shatter hardened skin armor.

data.name: G4Desc
data.value: Created by Kenny Ackerman and the Military Police Interior First Squad for anti-human combat. Replaces blades with dual-barreled scattershot pistols, allowing lethal close-quarters firepower combined with 3D aerial maneuvers.

data.name: G5Desc
data.value: Heavy fixed cannons and Wall-mounted Guillotine traps designed for city gate defense. Uses gravity-driven guillotine blades or heavy explosive canister shells to decapitate titans without risking infantry lives.

data.name: G6Desc
data.value: Color-coded smoke signal pistols devised by Commander Erwin Smith for the Long-Distance Scouting Formation. Red denotes titan sightings, green changes march vector, black signals abnormal titans, and yellow reports mission status over vast distances.

data.name: C7Title
data.value: Attack Titan / Founding Titan / War Hammer Titan

data.name: C7Bio
data.value: A former Scout who discovered he possessed the power of the Titans. Driven by an unwavering desire for freedom, he eventually initiated the Rumbling to protect Paradis.

data.name: C8Bio
data.value: A Marleyan Warrior who infiltrated the Walls. Struggled with a split personality due to the guilt of his actions. A formidable soldier with immense durability.

data.name: C9Bio
data.value: A lone wolf with exceptional martial arts skills. Served as the Female Titan for Marley. Spent years encased in a crystal after her capture by the Scouts.

data.value: Confidential records of humanity's finest and their adversaries.

data.name: Author_PageTitle
data.value: 諫山 創 (Hajime Isayama) - Attack on Titan Creator

data.name: Author_MetaDesc
data.value: Biography and details about Hajime Isayama, the creator and mangaka of Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin).

data.name: Author_Title
data.value: Creator & Illustrator of Attack on Titan

data.name: Author_Bio1
data.value: Born in Oyama, Ōita Prefecture, Japan, Hajime Isayama dreamed of creating manga from an early age. His breakthrough came when he moved to Tokyo and submitted a short version of Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin) to Kodansha. Despite early critiques of his raw art style, the series was serialized in Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine starting in 2009.

data.name: Author_Bio2
data.value: Over the next 12 years, Isayama crafted a narrative masterpiece that redefined modern dark fantasy and shōnen manga. Blending survival horror, political intrigue, and complex moral dilemmas, the story of humanity's struggle against the Titans captivated a global audience. The manga concluded in April 2021 after 139 chapters.

data.name: Author_Quote
data.value: "I think the story of Attack on Titan is about the struggle to break free from the cage of pre-determined destiny, and the heavy price of freedom."

data.name: Author_Award1Desc
data.value: Won the 35th annual award in the Shōnen category for Attack on Titan.

data.name: Author_Award2Desc
data.value: Awarded Best Foreign Series at the Napoli COMICON in Italy.

data.name: Author_Award3Desc
data.value: Nominated for Best American Edition of Foreign Material.

data.name: Author_Award4Desc
data.value: Honored with the Special 50th Anniversary Prize at the prestigious French festival.

data.name: Author_LegacyText
data.value: Isayama's work transcends standard pop culture. Attack on Titan has inspired major anime adaptations, live-action feature films, light novels, video games, and numerous academic essays exploring its complex themes of cyclical hatred, nationalism, and collective trauma. His storytelling is recognized globally for its intricate foreshadowing and unforgettable narrative payoffs.

data.name: CharGarrison_Bio
data.value: Stationed on the walls to defend the interior districts from breaches. Known for a fierce, unwavering loyalty to the people of Shiganshina.

data.name: CharMP_Bio
data.value: Commands the Military Police Brigade tasked with keeping order within the walls, often caught between civic duty and the corruption of the Interior.

data.name: CharInterior_Title
data.value: Chief of the First Interior Squad

data.name: CharInterior_Bio
data.value: A ruthless enforcer of the crown's will, wielding absolute authority over the Military Police's most secretive operations.

data.name: CharRoyal_Bio
data.value: Carries the blood of the true royal family, hidden from history to protect the secret of the Founding Titan.

data.name: CharGov_Bio
data.value: Serves within the walls' ruling administration, navigating the political machinery that has controlled Paradis for a century.

data.name: CharCivilian_Bio
data.value: A former Marleyan Warrior candidate who infiltrated Wall Maria disguised as a doctor, carrying the secret of the Attack and Founding Titans.

data.name: CharMarley_Bio
data.value: Raised from childhood on Paradis-hating propaganda, trained to inherit a Titan power and serve the Marleyan military.

data.name: CharTybur_Bio
data.value: Steward of the War Hammer Titan and the only family permitted to declare war on behalf of the Eldian people.

data.name: CharYeagerist_Bio
data.value: A former Scout who turned to radical loyalty toward Eren Yeager's cause after Marley's assault on Liberio.

data.name: Slide1_Quote
data.value: On that day, mankind received a grim reminder of the terror of being ruled by them...

data.name: Slide2_Quote
data.value: A person who cannot sacrifice anything, cannot change anything.

data.name: Slide3_Quote
data.value: I will exterminate them... every single one of them from this world!

data.name: CharHistoria_Bio
data.value: The illegitimate daughter of the Reiss royal bloodline, thrust into the crown after refusing to inherit the Founding Titan. Later ascended the throne to guide Paradis through its darkest hour.

data.name: CharYmir_Bio
data.value: A mysterious cadet of the 104th Training Corps who once held the Jaw Titan. Fiercely devoted to Historia, she sacrificed herself to protect the ones she loved.

data.name: CharSpecialOps_Bio
data.value: A founding member of Levi's original Special Operations Squad, chosen for exceptional skill with vertical maneuvering equipment and unwavering loyalty to the Scout Corps.

data.name: TitanFinal_Desc
data.value: The evolved form of the Founding Titan after the Rumbling, stripped of its ability to control the Nine Titans’ successors but still bound to Ymir’s curse.

data.name: TitanSonnyBean_Desc
data.value: A pair of pure titans captured alive by the Scout Corps for experimentation. Their behavior offered the first scientific insights into titan physiology and regeneration.

data.name: TitanWall_Desc
data.value: Countless titans embedded within the three walls since their construction, waiting to be awakened. Their existence remained hidden for a century until the truth was revealed.

data.name: Timeline_Event1_Desc
data.value: Ymir Fritz makes contact with the "Source of All Living Matter" (Devil of All Earth) and becomes the first Titan, the Founding Titan. She uses her power to build the Eldian Empire over 13 years.

data.name: Timeline_Event2_Desc
data.value: Ymir dies protecting King Fritz from a spear. Her power is divided among her three daughters, eventually creating the Nine Titans and the 13-year Curse of Ymir.

data.name: Timeline_Event3_Desc
data.value: The 145th King Karl Fritz, ashamed of Eldia's history, conspires with the Tybur family to end the civil war. Marley gains seven Titans; only the Attack Titan remains in hiding.

data.name: Timeline_Event4_Desc
data.value: King Fritz uses the Founding Titan to create the three Walls (Maria, Rose, Sina) from countless Colossus Titans. He erases the memories of Subjects of Ymir inside Paradis Island.

data.name: Timeline_Event5_Desc
data.value: After Zeke betrays the Eldian Restorationists, Grisha is exiled to Paradis. Eren Kruger (the Owl) saves him and passes the Attack Titan, tasking him to reclaim the Founding Titan.

data.name: Timeline_Event6_Desc
data.value: Human traffickers murder Mikasa's parents. Eren kills two traffickers; Mikasa's Ackerman power awakens and she kills the third. She becomes the Yeagers' adopted daughter.

data.name: Timeline_Event7_Desc
data.value: The Colossus and Armored Titans breach Wall Maria at Shiganshina. Humanity retreats to Wall Rose. Eren's mother Carla is eaten by a Titan (later revealed as Dina Fritz).

data.name: Timeline_Event8_Desc
data.value: Grisha massacres the Reiss family in the chapel crypt, steals the Founding Titan from Frieda, and forces Eren to eat him, inheriting both the Attack and Founding Titans.

data.name: Timeline_Event9_Desc
data.value: The government launches a reclamation operation using 20% of the population (250,000 people). The mission fails catastrophically, and Wall Maria is officially abandoned.

data.name: Timeline_Event10_Desc
data.value: The Colossus Titan breaches Wall Rose at Trost. Eren discovers his Titan-shifting ability after being eaten. He seals the gate with a boulder, humanity's first victory against Titans.

data.name: Timeline_Event11_Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps departs to capture the Female Titan in the interior. Annie (Female Titan) massacres the right flank. The mission fails with heavy casualties.

data.name: Timeline_Event12_Desc
data.value: Annie is lured into Stohess and reveals herself as the Female Titan. Eren battles her; she is captured but crystallizes herself. A Titan is revealed inside the Wall.

data.name: Timeline_Event13_Desc
data.value: Zeke's Beast Titan transforms Ragako villagers into Pure Titans. Reiner and Bertholdt reveal themselves as Armored and Colossus Titans, kidnapping Eren and Ymir.

data.name: Timeline_Event14_Desc
data.value: Reiner transforms into the Armored Titan and seizes Eren atop Wall Rose, while Bertholdt takes Ymir, who chooses to go with them. The Warriors begin their return march toward Marley with the Founding Titan in hand.

data.name: Timeline_Event15_Desc
data.value: Still recovering from injury, Commander Erwin personally leads a cavalry pursuit through Titan-infested territory to recover Eren before the Warriors escape beyond humanity's reach.

data.name: Timeline_Event16_Desc
data.value: The Smiling Titan that killed Eren's mother reappears during the pursuit. Hannes engages it alone to atone for his failure at Shiganshina, and is devoured before Eren's eyes.

data.name: Timeline_Event17_Desc
data.value: In despair, Eren strikes the Smiling Titan secretly Dina Fritz of the royal bloodline and unknowingly activates the Founding Titan's Coordinate power, turning nearby Pure Titans against the Warriors.

data.name: Timeline_Event18_Desc
data.value: Overwhelmed by the Coordinate's power, Reiner and Bertholdt abandon their attempt to capture Eren and withdraw. Ymir chooses to go with them, and both sides now brace for a decisive clash over Shiganshina.

data.name: Timeline_Event19_Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps stages a coup against the corrupt royal government, exposing the Reiss family as the true bloodline hidden from history.

data.name: Lore_MetaDesc
data.value: Explore the world of Attack on Titan, the Nine Titans, the Three Walls, factions, nations, and the mysterious Paths realm.

data.name: Lore_PageSub
data.value: Dive deep into the world-building of Attack on Titan, from the power of the Nine Titans to the geopolitics of Paradis and Marley.

data.name: Lore_TitansIntro
data.value: Two thousand years ago, Ymir Fritz obtained the Power of the Titans. Upon her death, that power was split into Nine, each carrying a unique ability passed down through the ages.

data.name: Lore_WallsIntro
data.value: One hundred years before the fall of Wall Maria, King Karl Fritz erected three concentric walls of Colossal Titans to shield the remnants of Eldia on Paradis Island.

data.name: Lore_FactionsIntro
data.value: The world of Attack on Titan is shaped by the bitter conflict between nations and military organizations, each with their own ideologies and agendas.

data.name: Lore_T1_Inheritors
data.value: Ymir Fritz → Karl Fritz → Frieda Reiss → Grisha Yeager → Eren Yeager

data.name: Lore_T6_Inheritors
data.value: Marcel Galliard → Ymir → Porco Galliard → Falco Grice

data.name: Lore_T9_Inheritors
data.value: Eren Kruger → Grisha Yeager → Eren Yeager

data.name: Lore_T1_Ability
data.value: Commands all titans, alters Eldian memories, controls the Paths, the ultimate power of the Founding bloodline.

data.name: Lore_T2_Ability
data.value: Mimicry of other titan abilities through training, selective body hardening, and a scream that attracts nearby Pure Titans.

data.name: Lore_T3_Ability
data.value: Devastating long-range projectile attacks and the ability to transform and command Subjects of Ymir via spinal fluid.

data.name: Lore_T4_Ability
data.value: Explosive nuclear-like transformation, superheated steam emission, and overwhelming destructive power at 60 meters tall.

data.name: Lore_T5_Ability
data.value: Full-body hardened armor plating impervious to most conventional weaponry, with the ability to selectively harden or shed plates.

data.name: Lore_T6_Ability
data.value: Crystalline jaw and claws capable of crushing nearly anything, including titan hardening. combined with exceptional speed and agility.

data.name: Lore_T7_Ability
data.value: Extreme endurance for prolonged operations. Its quadrupedal form can carry heavy cargo, mounted artillery, and serve as a mobile platform.

data.name: Lore_T8_Ability
data.value: Creates weapons and structures from hardened titan flesh at will. Can operate remotely via a crystal tether, keeping the user hidden underground.

data.name: Lore_T9_Ability
data.value: Inherits memories from future holders, granting prophetic foresight. Driven by an unwavering, unbreakable will to fight for freedom.

data.name: Lore_Wall1_Desc
data.value: The outermost wall and the first line of defense for humanity within the walls. Wall Maria was breached by the Colossal and Armored Titans in Year 845, forcing hundreds of thousands of refugees inward and triggering the central conflict of the story.

data.name: Lore_Wall2_Desc
data.value: The middle wall that became humanity's front line after the fall of Wall Maria. Trost District saw the first successful defense against a titan breach, thanks to Eren's newly discovered titan-shifting ability.

data.name: Lore_Wall3_Desc
data.value: The innermost wall, home to the royal capital and the ruling elite. Behind Wall Sina, the nobility live in relative luxury while the outer districts struggle. The Military Police Brigade maintains order here and guards the Crown's darkest secrets.

data.name: Lore_F1_Desc
data.value: The expeditionary branch of the military that ventures beyond the walls to combat titans and explore the outside world. Despite suffering the highest casualty rate of any branch, the Survey Corps embodies humanity's hope and defiance.

data.name: Lore_F1_Members
data.value: Erwin Smith, Levi Ackerman, Hange Zoë, Eren Yeager, Mikasa Ackerman, Armin Arlert

data.name: Lore_F2_Desc
data.value: The largest military branch, responsible for patrolling and maintaining the walls. Garrison soldiers man the fixed artillery atop the walls and serve as the primary defense during titan breaches.

data.name: Lore_F2_Members
data.value: Dot Pixis, Hannes, Ian Dietrich, Rico Brzenska

data.name: Lore_F3_Desc
data.value: The elite force operating within Wall Sina, tasked with maintaining order and protecting the royal government. Acceptance requires graduating in the top 10 of a training class. Despite its prestige, the Brigade is rife with corruption.

data.name: Lore_F3_Members
data.value: Nile Dok, Kenny Ackerman, Marlo Freudenberg

data.name: Lore_F4_Desc
data.value: The island nation where the remnants of the Eldian Empire live behind the three walls. Ruled by the Fritz / Reiss royal family, Paradis was kept in ignorance of the outside world for over a century by the Founding Titan's memory wipe.

data.name: Lore_F4_Members
data.value: Historia Reiss (Queen), Rod Reiss, Darius Zackly

data.name: Lore_F5_Desc
data.value: A vast continental power that subjugates Eldians in internment zones and weaponizes titan powers for military expansion. Marley controls seven of the Nine Titans and uses Eldian "Warriors" as frontline soldiers in foreign wars.

data.name: Lore_F6_Desc
data.value: Marley's elite Eldian soldiers who inherit titan powers and fight on behalf of the nation that oppresses their people. Selected as children, Warriors are promised "honorary Marleyan" status for their families in return for service.

data.name: Lore_F6_Members
data.value: Reiner Braun, Bertolt Hoover, Annie Leonhart, Zeke Yeager, Pieck Finger, Porco Galliard, Falco Grice, Gabi Braun

data.name: Lore_F7_Desc
data.value: An eastern nation with historical ties to the Eldian Empire through the Azumabito clan. Hizuru is one of the few foreign powers willing to negotiate with Paradis, driven by both diplomatic pragmatism and ancestral obligation.

data.name: Lore_Paths_Subtitle
data.value: The invisible threads connecting all Subjects of Ymir

data.name: Lore_Paths_Desc1
data.value: The Paths are an invisible metaphysical realm that connects every Subject of Ymir across time and space. Through these paths, the flesh, bones, and memories of titans are transmitted when a new inheritor devours the previous holder. At the nexus of all paths lies the Coordinate - the source of the Founding Titan's absolute power.

data.name: Lore_Paths_Desc2
data.value: Within this timeless dimension, Ymir Fritz - the original Founder, has existed for two thousand years, ceaselessly building every titan from sand at the command of the royal bloodline. It was only when Eren Yeager reached the Coordinate that the cycle was finally broken.

data.name: Lore_Paths_YmirDesc
data.value: A young slave girl who, over 2,000 years ago, made contact with the "source of all living matter" and became the first titan. After her death, her soul was trapped in the Paths, endlessly building titans in servitude to the royal bloodline, until she was finally freed.

data.name: Lore_Paths_CoordinateDesc
data.value: The nexus where all Paths converge. Whoever controls the Coordinate can command all Subjects of Ymir, altering their memories, bodies, and even their reproductive capabilities. Accessing its full power requires both the Founding Titan and royal blood.

data.name: CharHolger_Bio
data.value: A Survey Corps soldier who joined the Yeagerists, supporting Floch Forster during the coup.

data.name: Timeline_Event20_Desc
data.value: Historia Reiss kills her titanized father Rod and accepts the crown, becoming the first monarch in a century to know the truth behind the Founding Titan.

data.name: Timeline_Event21_Desc
data.value: Commander Erwin's plan to retake Shiganshina is approved, betting Eren's hardening ability against the promise of finally reaching Grisha's hidden basement.

data.name: Timeline_Event22_Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps advances into an eerily empty Shiganshina. Armin realizes the silence isn't safety, the Warriors have been hiding in wait all along.

data.name: Timeline_Event23_Desc
data.value: Reiner, Bertholdt, and the Beast Titan spring a coordinated ambush, encircling the Survey Corps with Pure Titans in the largest Titan Shifter battle yet fought.

data.name: Timeline_Event24_Desc
data.value: The Beast Titan commands the encirclement from atop Wall Maria, bombarding the trapped Survey Corps with hurled rock and cutting off every route of retreat.

data.name: Timeline_Event25_Desc
data.value: Erwin leads a suicidal cavalry charge to draw the Beast Titan's fire, giving a moving speech on sacrifice before nearly the entire formation is wiped out.

data.name: Timeline_Event26_Desc
data.value: Using the chaos of Erwin's charge, Levi closes in on the Beast Titan, severing its limbs and pulling Zeke from the nape before the Cart Titan snatches him away.

data.name: Timeline_Event27_Desc
data.value: Armin clings to the Colossal Titan's teeth, letting himself burn to exhaust Bertholdt's steam, buying Eren the opening he needs to strike from behind.

data.name: Timeline_Event28_Desc
data.value: With only one Titan serum and two dying leaders, Levi chooses to save Armin over Erwin, letting Armin inherit the Colossal Titan and reshaping who leads Paradis next.

data.name: Timeline_Event29_Desc
data.value: Grisha's hidden journals and photographs prove the outside world was never destroyed, humanity was deliberately isolated on Paradis, and the century-long royal deception collapses.

data.name: Timeline_Event30_Desc
data.value: The Survey Corps reaches the ocean for the first time in Paradis history. Eren asks whether freedom requires destroying every enemy beyond it, the war's next chapter begins.

data.name: Timeline_Event31_Desc
data.value: With the outside world confirmed, Paradis races to modernize its military and technology, developing new weapons like the Thunder Spear in preparation for the coming conflict with Marley.

data.name: Timeline_Event32_Desc
data.value: Eren infiltrates Marley and launches a devastating surprise attack on Liberio during Willy Tybur's public address, consuming the War Hammer Titan in front of the world.

data.name: Timeline_Event33_Desc
data.value: The Liberio raid ends any hope of quiet diplomacy, Paradis and Marley are now locked in open, total war.

data.name: Timeline_Event34_Desc
data.value: As the Survey Corps escapes aboard a captured airship, a cornered Gabi Braun shoots and kills Sasha Blouse, leaving her surviving comrades devastated.

data.name: Timeline_Event35_Desc
data.value: Loyalists to Eren, led by Floch Forster, stage a coup on Paradis, imprisoning the government and seizing military control in Eren's name.

data.name: Timeline_Event36_Desc
data.value: Zeke secretly laces wine served to the Survey Corps with his spinal fluid, planning to trigger a mass Titanization the moment he roars, a plot narrowly discovered in time.

data.name: Timeline_Event37_Desc
data.value: In the Paths, Eren and Zeke walk through Grisha's memories and meet Ymir Fritz herself, revealing 2,000 years of servitude at the root of every Titan's curse.

data.name: Timeline_Event38_Desc
data.value: Eren Yeager activated the Power of the Founding Titan, unleashing millions of Wall Titans in a cataclysmic march to annihilate all life beyond Paradis.

data.name: Timeline_Event39_Desc
data.value: The Wall Titans cross the sea and reach Marley's mainland, crushing everything in their path as the world watches humanity's oldest nightmare made real on a global scale.

data.name: Timeline_Event40_Desc
data.value: Survivors from Paradis and former Marleyan Warriors set aside decades of hatred to form an unlikely alliance, united by the single goal of stopping Eren.

data.name: Timeline_Event41_Desc
data.value: The allied forces make their last stand against Eren's rampaging Founding Titan, fighting to buy time for a final, desperate assault on the Founder itself.

data.name: Timeline_Event42_Desc
data.value: In the Paths, Zeke finally understands the meaning of life through Armin's memories and willingly lets Levi end his life, freeing him from Eren's control.

data.name: Timeline_Event43_Desc
data.value: With the world's forces converging on the Founder, Mikasa Ackerman severs Eren's head, ending the Rumbling and fulfilling the promise she made him years before.

data.name: Timeline_Event44_Desc
data.value: With Eren's death, Ymir Fritz is finally freed from 2,000 years of servitude and relinquishes the Power of the Titans, the curse ends, and Titan shifting vanishes from the world forever.

data.name: Timeline_Event45_Desc
data.value: Three years after the Rumbling, the alliance's survivors work to broker a fragile peace between Paradis and the nations of the world it nearly destroyed.

data.name: Timeline_Event46_Desc
data.value: Without the Founding Titan's deterrent, Paradis begins rebuilding its military from scratch, uncertain whether the fragile peace will hold against a world still wary of Eldians.

data.name: Timeline_Event47_Desc
data.value: A haunting final-page glimpse suggests peace did not last, Paradis lies in ruins generations later, leaving the epilogue's meaning deliberately open to interpretation.

data.name: Timeline_Event48_Desc
data.value: In a peaceful future, a boy stumbles upon the great tree where Mikasa laid Eren to rest, closing the story on a quiet note of memory and hope.

data.name: CurseIntro
data.value: No Titan Shifter can survive more than 13 years after first inheriting their power - a rule that traces back to Ymir Fritz herself, and one that governs every major decision made by every Shifter in the series.

data.name: Curse_CountdownValue
data.value: The 13-year clock begins the instant a person first acquires any Titan power.

data.name: Curse_NoResetValue
data.value: Inheriting additional Titans - as Eren did with Attack, Founding, and War Hammer - never resets the clock.

data.name: Curse_UniversalValue
data.value: All Nine Titans are equally bound - royal bloodline or not, no Shifter is exempt.

data.name: Curse_DeteriorationValue
data.value: As the limit nears, Shifters experience visible, progressive physical decline.

data.name: Curse_NoExceptionsValue
data.value: In recorded history, not a single Shifter has ever survived past the 13-year mark.

data.name: EnlistDesc
data.value: The Training Corps has concluded. Select your military branch to explore their specialized weaponry, armor, and combat strategies.

data.name: ChronicleDesc
data.value: From the tragic awakening of Ymir Fritz to the eventual undoing of the wall crystallization, the history of Eldia is written in blood. Step inside the absolute timeline tracking the secret operations of the Great Titan War and the full tactical records of the Paradis defense campaigns.

data.name: ChronicleBtn
data.value: Explore the History of the Eldian Empire

data.name: Quote1_Text
data.value: If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win!

data.name: Quote2_Text
data.value: Someone who cannot sacrifice anything, can never change anything.

data.name: Quote3_Text
data.value: Give up on your dreams and die. Lead the recruits straight into hell.

data.name: Quote4_Text
data.value: My soldiers, rage! My soldiers, scream! My soldiers, fight!

data.name: Quote5_Text
data.value: This world is cruel, and it's also very beautiful.

data.name: Quote6_Text
data.value: If you don't want to die... think. Even if it's just a tiny spark, find a way out.

data.name: Quote7_Text
data.value: The only thing we're allowed to do... is to believe that we won't regret the choice we made.

data.name: Timeline_E845_M_Text
data.value: Colossal Titan destroyed Shiganshina gate. Titans have flooded the interior. Humanity has abandoned the region.

data.name: Timeline_E845_R_Text
data.value: Currently safe. Armed Garrison forces are actively reinforcing the barricades along the southern frontline districts.

data.name: Timeline_E845_S_Text
data.value: The royal district remains untouched. Protected strictly by the Military Police Brigade to shield the true crown.

data.name: Timeline_E850_M_Text
data.value: Territory completely given up. Retaken attempts are strictly banned pending the Scout Survey expeditions.

data.name: Timeline_E850_R_Text
data.value: Trost gate breached but plugged via Eren Yeager's Titan form. Armor Titan threat detected nearby.

data.name: Timeline_E850_S_Text
data.value: Stohess District structurally damaged. Female Titan captured inside the walls after devastating urban combat.

data.name: Timeline_E854_M_Text
data.value: The hardening has completely dissolved. The ancient Wall Titans have woken up to begin their global march.

data.name: Timeline_E854_R_Text
data.value: Wall shattered into debris as millions of massive Colossal giants walked straight out of the structures.

data.name: Timeline_E854_S_Text
data.value: The absolute protective layout of the kingdom has dissolved. Complete chaos erupts across the royal capital.

data.name: Bio_LeviAckerman
data.value: Possesses near-superhuman reflexes due to awakened Ackerman bloodlines. Unmatched with vertical maneuvering equipment, universally hailed as Humanity's Strongest.

data.name: Bio_MikasaAckerman
data.value: Equal to a hundred ordinary soldiers in combat. Graduated from the 104th Training Corps alongside Eren, driven by an absolute, singular drive to protect him at all costs.

data.name: Bio_HangeZoe
data.value: Led the Scout Corps' scientific research and weapon development, notably creating the Thunder Spears. Succeeded Erwin as the 14th Commander with high integrity.

data.name: Bio_ErwinSmith
data.value: A legendary leader with frozen resolve and hypnotic charisma. Developed the Long-Distance Scouting Formation. Sacrificed himself to historical truth.

data.name: Bio_JeanKirstein
data.value: A grounded realist who understands weakness, enabling him to assess battlefields accurately from a soldier's view. Became a highly trusted field commander.

data.name: Bio_ArminArlert
data.value: Eren and Mikasa's childhood friend. Possesses an extraordinary tactical mind, devising brilliant counter-strategies in dire situations. Inherited the Colossal Titan.

data.name: Title_ErenYeager
data.value: Attack Titan / Founding Titan / War Hammer Titan

data.name: Bio_ErenYeager
data.value: A former Scout who discovered he possessed the power of the Titans. Driven by an unwavering desire for freedom, he eventually initiated the Rumbling to protect Paradis.

data.name: Bio_Ymir
data.value: A mysterious cadet of the 104th Training Corps who once held the Jaw Titan. Fiercely devoted to Historia, she sacrificed herself to protect the ones she loved.

data.name: Bio_HistoriaReiss
data.value: The illegitimate daughter of the Reiss royal bloodline, thrust into the crown after refusing to inherit the Founding Titan. Later ascended the throne to guide Paradis through its darkest hour.

data.name: Bio_FoundingTitan
data.value: The nexus of all titans. Wields the ultimate 'Coordinate' ability to alter memories and command millions of Wall Titans to initiate the Cataclysmic 'Rumbling'.

data.name: Bio_FinalFoundingTitan
data.value: The evolved form of the Founding Titan after the Rumbling, stripped of its ability to control the Nine Titans’ successors but still bound to Ymir’s curse.

data.name: Bio_AttackTitan
data.value: The core combat avatar managed by Eren Yeager. Features balanced combat stats, flawless tactical grit, and the unique cross-temporal memory foresight capability.

data.name: Bio_ArmoredTitan
data.value: Held by Reiner Braun. Encased in a heavy hardened skeletal armor plating that provides fortress-grade defensive metrics. Functions as an organic battering ram against fortified structures.

data.name: Bio_BeastTitan
data.value: Held by Zeke Yeager. Resembles an ape-like beast capable of devastating long-range bombardment. Due to royal blood, his spinal fluid instantly transforms targets.

data.name: Bio_CartTitan
data.value: Held by Pieck Finger. Utilizes a quadrupedal stance with unparalleled physiological endurance, allowing months of sustained transformation. Can be equipped with customized heavy military artillery.

data.name: Bio_ColossalTitan
data.value: Held by Bertholdt, then Armin. Possesses a mountainous structure. Transformation triggers a pseudo-nuclear thermal blast, alongside a tactical high-pressure burning steam defensive barrier.

data.name: Bio_FemaleTitan
data.value: Possessed by Annie Leonhart. Exhibits high all-around agility, specialized localized crystalline hardening defenses, and a vocal call that summons pure titans.

data.name: Bio_JawTitan
data.value: Held by Ymir, Falco, and others. The smallest form but unmatched in top-tier agility. Features powerful claws and jaws that can crush even the densest crystalline hardening.

data.name: Bio_WarhammerTitan
data.value: Originally held by the Tybur family. Features absolute weapon materialization via dense structural hardening. The host can safely remain underground while managing the titan puppet remotely via a cable connection.

data.name: Bio_SonnyAndBean
data.value: A pair of pure titans captured alive by the Scout Corps for experimentation. Their behavior offered the first scientific insights into titan physiology and regeneration.

data.name: Bio_WallTitans
data.value: Countless titans embedded within the three walls since their construction, waiting to be awakened. Their existence remained hidden for a century until the truth was revealed.

data.name: Bio_EldJinn
data.value: Senior member of Levi's hand-picked Special Operations Squad. Calm and experienced, Eld served as the steadying voice of reason among the squad's younger members.

data.name: Bio_OluoBozado
data.value: Boastful but skilled veteran of the Special Operations Squad who idolises Levi and copies his mannerisms. His bravado barely hides genuine bravery earned through countless battles.

data.name: Bio_PetraRal
data.value: Compassionate and dedicated member of Levi's Squad with an impressive 48-titan kill record. Her death at the hands of the Female Titan marked a devastating loss for the Survey Corps.

data.name: Bio_GntherSchultz
data.value: Methodical veteran of Levi's Squad known for his calm assessment in the heat of battle. He was the first of the squad to fall, betrayed by the disguised Female Titan.

data.name: Title_Hannes
data.value: Captain of the Garrison – Trost District

data.name: Bio_Hannes
data.value: Loyal captain of the Garrison who failed to protect Carla Yeager from the Smiling Titan out of fear. He redeems himself years later by sacrificing his life to protect Eren and Mikasa.

data.name: Title_DotPixis
data.value: High Commander of the Southern Territory

data.name: Bio_DotPixis
data.value: Eccentric yet brilliant Garrison commander who orchestrates the recapture of Trost District. Known for his love of spirits and his unerring ability to inspire troops in hopeless situations.

data.name: Title_RicoBrzenska
data.value: Leader of the Garrison's Elite Squad

data.name: Bio_RicoBrzenska
data.value: Sharp-tongued but dependable Squad Leader who fought to defend Trost. Known for her exceptional ODM gear skill and her pragmatic battlefield decision-making.

data.name: Title_NileDok
data.value: Commander of the Military Police Brigade

data.name: Bio_NileDok
data.value: Commander of the Military Police who often clashes with Erwin Smith over strategy. Though bound by protocol, he proves his humanity in the final moments of the Rumbling crisis.

data.name: Bio_MarloweFreudenberg
data.value: Idealistic recruit who joins the Military Police determined to reform it from within. His moral compass ultimately leads him to join the Survey Corps in their uprising against the crown.

data.name: Bio_HitchDreyse
data.value: Carefree on the surface, Hitch is sharper than she lets on. Her unlikely friendship with Annie Leonhart reveals a more empathetic side beneath her flippant exterior.

data.name: Bio_BorisFeulner
data.value: A Military Police officer assigned to oversee operations in the interior. He carries out orders from above with unwavering obedience, even when those orders cross moral lines.

data.name: Title_KennyAckerman
data.value: Captain of the Anti-Personnel Control Squad

data.name: Bio_KennyAckerman
data.value: Legendary killer and former mentor to Levi. He leads the crown's Anti-Personnel Control Squad with lethal precision, driven by his own ambition to obtain the power of the Titans.

data.name: Bio_TrauteCarven
data.value: A member of Kenny's elite Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Trained to fight humans rather than Titans, she uses specially crafted ODM gear loaded with anti-human weapons.

data.name: Bio_DjelSanes
data.value: Sadistic torturer and loyal enforcer of the Royal Government who will do anything to suppress dissent. His brutal methods are eventually turned against him during the Uprising arc.

data.name: Title_Fritz
data.value: Member of the Reiss Royal Family

data.name: Bio_Fritz
data.value: A member of the Reiss bloodline and sibling of Frieda Reiss. He witnessed Grisha Yeager's attack on the Reiss family chapel and carries the trauma of that night.

data.name: Title_RodReiss
data.value: Head of the Reiss Royal Family

data.name: Bio_RodReiss
data.value: Patriarch of the true royal bloodline who manipulates his children for political gain. His cowardice is laid bare when he chooses monstrous transformation over facing Eren himself.

data.name: Bio_FriedaReiss
data.value: Legitimate heir to the throne and holder of the Founding Titan before Eren. Constrained by the Vow Renouncing War, her memories and power were devoured by Grisha Yeager.

data.name: Bio_Aurille
data.value: Serves within the walls' ruling administration, navigating the political machinery that has controlled Paradis for a century.

data.name: Bio_Deltoff
data.value: Serves within the walls' ruling administration, navigating the political machinery that has controlled Paradis for a century.

data.name: Bio_Gerald
data.value: Serves within the walls' ruling administration, navigating the political machinery that has controlled Paradis for a century.

data.name: Bio_Roderich
data.value: Serves within the walls' ruling administration, navigating the political machinery that has controlled Paradis for a century.

data.name: Bio_GrishaYeager
data.value: A former Marleyan Warrior candidate who infiltrated Wall Maria disguised as a doctor, carrying the secret of the Attack and Founding Titans.

data.name: Title_MinisterNick
data.value: Minister of the Church of the Walls

data.name: Bio_MinisterNick
data.value: Zealous minister of the Wall Cult who knows the secret truth of the Walls — that Titans are sealed inside them. He refuses to reveal this truth even under torture, dying to protect the secret.

data.name: Bio_DimoReeves
data.value: Self-serving merchant guild president who initially cooperates with the Royal Government. His encounter with the Survey Corps gradually awakens his sense of responsibility to Trost.

data.name: Bio_Kaya
data.value: A girl from the Liberio internment zone who was saved by Sasha Braus after her mother was devoured by a Titan. Her friendship with Gabi challenges deep-seated hatred on both sides.

data.name: Bio_CalviTheMarshal
data.value: The supreme commander of Marley's armed forces during the war against Paradis. A pragmatic strategist who prioritises military outcomes over political diplomacy.

data.name: Bio_TheoMagathAcommander
data.value: Strict and calculating Commander of Marley's Warrior Unit. He eventually questions the cycle of Titan warfare and resolves to end it — even at the cost of his own life.

data.name: Bio_ReinerBraun
data.value: Holder of the Armored Titan, torn between his Marleyan warrior identity and the bonds he formed on Paradis. His fractured psyche developed a split personality to cope.

data.name: Bio_ZekeYeager
data.value: Half-brother of Eren and holder of the Beast Titan. The mastermind behind the 'euthanasia plan' — a scheme to end Eldian suffering by preventing future births.

data.name: Bio_BertoltHoover
data.value: Holder of the Colossal Titan and childhood friend of Reiner. His gentle exterior conceals a catastrophic power that toppled Wall Maria.

data.name: Bio_AnnieLeonhart
data.value: Former Marley Warrior candidate who infiltrated Paradis as the Female Titan shifter. Renowned for her crystal-hardening technique and enigmatic loyalty.

data.name: Bio_MarcelGalliard
data.value: Former holder of the Jaw Titan and older brother of Porco. His death protecting Reiner set the entire Paradis infiltration in motion.

data.name: Bio_PorcoGalliard
data.value: Abrasive and proud holder of the Jaw Titan. He carries resentment toward Reiner, believing the Armored Titan should have been his brother Marcel's.

data.name: Bio_PieckFinger
data.value: Cunning and analytical holder of the Cart Titan. She endures a quadrupedal Titan form longer than any other, providing critical tactical support on the battlefield.

data.name: Bio_GabiBraun
data.value: Fiercely patriotic Warrior candidate who idolises Marley and despises the island's Eldians. Her worldview is gradually shattered through her experiences on Paradis.

data.name: Bio_FalcoGrice
data.value: Kind-hearted Warrior candidate who inherits the Jaw Titan. He risks everything to protect Gabi and the people he loves.

data.name: Bio_ColtGrice
data.value: Elder brother of Falco and the candidate designated to inherit the Beast Titan. Deeply devoted to his family above all else.

data.name: Title_WillyTybur
data.value: Lord of the Tybur Family – Diplomat

data.name: Bio_WillyTybur
data.value: Charismatic public face of the noble Tybur family. He staged a grand theatrical production in Liberio to declare war on Paradis, fully aware it would end his life and spark a new world war.

data.name: Title_LaraTybur
data.value: Head of the Tybur Family / War Hammer Titan

data.name: Bio_LaraTybur
data.value: True holder of the War Hammer Titan and actual head of the Tybur family. While her brother Willy conducted diplomacy, Lara was the family's ultimate weapon — until Eren devoured her.

data.name: Bio_Holger
data.value: A Survey Corps soldier who joined the Yeagerists, supporting Floch Forster during the coup.

data.name: Bio_Theantimarleyanvolunteers
data.value: A group of Eldians from outside the Walls who despise Marley's oppression. Led by Yelena, they ally with Zeke Yeager and supply Paradis with crucial intelligence and military aid.

data.name: Bio_Underground
data.value: The subterranean slum beneath Stohess District where society's outcasts live. It is the birthplace of Kenny Ackerman and the young Levi, a place of crime and survival where the weak are exploited.
